title: A flat finitely presented algebra with geometrically integral fibres is projective over the base, without Noetherian hypotheses
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma extends the projectivity statement to the non Noetherian case: a flat finitely presented algebra with geometrically integral fibres over an arbitrary ring is projective as a module (statement lines 2246-2256, tag 05FZ-adjacent). The proof approximates the situation by one of finite type over the integers preserving the hypotheses, applies the Noetherian statement to that approximation, and ascends projectivity along the base change to the given base. The approximation step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
